author: Vizeu
body:
~ I changed my Minecraft username to ParkChanJi from Vizualz. 
~ I was banned for Hacking - Forcefield, Kill Aura: http://prnt.sc/8xtfgs
~ The reason why I should be unbanned from the server is because.. Well, I wasn't hacking. I was playing the gamemode Nexus if I'm not mistaken, and I chose the Scout kit. And with the Scout Kit I was strafing so I guess it made it look like I was getting crazy hits. And I was also lagging, since I live in Asia and I get around 250-280 ping. Unfortunately I don't have any evidence since I wasn't recording or anything like that. But if you want me to show you my Minecraft Profile or anything like that, then contact me on Skype: vizzychan
